reason: $24.99 for 30 days is still above the $19 to $23 I already see for magnesium, and I wait for coupons and flash sales anyway. The lab report is nice, but I would not pay extra for it on a budget this tight.
objection: I can get a month of magnesium for $19 to $23, so why pay $25 to $30 for a sachet? I do not need a pocket-sized packet badly enough to pay more.
would_change_my_mind: A flash sale or coupon that brings the first box to about $19 or less, or a cheaper trial size.
